zh: 修复「智能体状态雷达」弹窗点击正在运行的桌面 Agent（Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / WorkBuddy）对话报错「会话标识无效」与底部提示只读的问题：雷达跳转现统一传入完整会话对象并自动切换至对话视图；`HomeDesktopAgents.open` 兼容传参重载与列表元数据合并，确保侧栏高亮与历史消息加载正常。
修复长对话列表中较早的置顶会话被新会话挤出首屏分页的问题：置顶会话现按自定义排序始终优先返回，并支持按改名别名检索。
修复侧栏「查看已归档对话」与手机端归档列表遗漏问题：切换归档视图时直接向后端按 archived=1/0 分页拉取，同时将首屏分页扩至 80 条以完整保留空间对话；手机端 `/api/ai/sessions-archive` 同步兼容通过列表归档的会话。
en: Fixed clicking running desktop agent conversations (Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / WorkBuddy) from the Agent Status Radar showing invalid session ID errors and read-only footer: radar navigation now passes the complete session entity and switches to chat mode; `HomeDesktopAgents.open` supports parameter overloads and merges metadata from the active list to preserve sidebar highlights and message timeline loading.
Fixed older pinned conversations dropping off page 1 when newer sessions exceed the page limit: active pinned chats now sort first by pin_order and match custom alias titles during search.

Fixed Web and Mobile archived views missing preference-archived conversations: switching to Archived now queries the backend directly (archived=1/0), increased initial sidebar page size to 80 to retain workspace chats, and included preference-archived sessions in `/api/ai/sessions-archive`.
